name: WNDRLX
kurzbeschreibung: Bistro and à la carte restaurant WNDRLX (Wanderlux) with bar, lounge and fireplace in St. Leonhard im Pitztal at the end of the Pitztal valley.
beschreibung:
Overview

The WNDRLX – also referred to in the sources as Wanderlux – is a bistro and à la carte restaurant in St. Leonhard im Pitztal in Tyrol. It is located in the district of Mittelberg 83 (postal code 6481) and thus lies at the end of the Pitztal valley, surrounded by the mountain ranges of the Austrian Eastern Alps, near the village of St. Leonhard. The dining area is officially listed as “WNDRLX À LA CARTE RESTAURANT”. The property combines a bistro, bar, lobby and a lounge with an open fireplace; in addition there is the WNDRLX Library with comfortable armchairs and cosy seating corners. The focus is on first-class comfort and sincere hospitality – a mix of a cosy atmosphere, genuine care and well-kept furnishings, as the establishment's own website describes it.

History/Background

Reliable information about the origins of the establishment cannot be derived from the available sources. What is certain is that Wanderlux lies at the end of the Pitztal valley and appears there as a resort with a dining offering. The bistro area is located in the “Eat – Drink – Events” section and serves guests as a place to rest and be pampered after an eventful, often sweaty day. Further historical details are deliberately not asserted here.

Getting There

According to its own information, the WNDRLX is only about 90 km from Innsbruck Airport and is easy to reach both by car and by public transport. The address is Mittelberg 83, 6481 St. Leonhard im Pitztal, Tyrol – Austria. The coordinates given (46°57'25.4"N, 10°52'31.5"E) point to the end of the valley. A Google Maps link is available for specific route planning; questions about getting there can be asked by phone at +43 664 3842250.

Tips

Anyone who wants a place in the bistro can reserve a table by phone at +43 664 3842250 or by email at restaurant@wndrlx.com. In addition to the à la carte offering, there is a small (snack) menu in summer, served from Tuesday to Saturday from 15:30 to 19:30. The property includes a bar, lobby, a lounge with an open fireplace as well as the WNDRLX Library – ideal for a quiet close to the day. Through general contact channels such as hello@wndrlx.com, the team also answers questions about stays and activities in the region.

Best Time to Travel

The Pitztal is a destination in both winter and summer. The published opening hours of the bistro cover a summer period (26.06.–29.08.2026) with a daily drinks offering and a winter period (24.10.2026–17.04.2027) with continuous operation without a closing day. Anyone wishing to make use of the bistro should check the current season and the daily opening hours in advance.
